import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Total Sales by Product
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(product_sales))
bars1 = ax1.barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
# Add value labels
for bar, val in zip(bars1, product_sales.values):
    ax1.text(val + 50, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'${val:,.0f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)

# Plot 2: Sales Distribution by Customer Age Group
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)
colors2 = sns.color_palette('mako', len(age_sales))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(age_sales.values, labels=age_sales.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors2,
                                    explode=[0.02]*len(age_sales), shadow=True)
ax2.set_title('Sales Distribution by Customer Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
plt.setp(autotexts, size=9, weight='bold')

# Plot 3: Average Transaction Value by Size and Payment Method
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
pivot_data = df.pivot_table(values='total', index='size', columns='payment_method', 
                            aggfunc='mean').reindex(size_order)
pivot_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=sns.color_palette('Set2', 3), edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax3.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Average Transaction by Size & Payment Method', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Payment Method', loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
ax3.set_xticklabels(ax3.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Plot 4: Takeaway vs Dine-in by Product (Stacked Bar)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
takeaway_df = df.groupby(['product', 'is_takeaway'])['quantity'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
takeaway_df.columns = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
takeaway_df.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax4, 
                 color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'], edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax4.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Quantity Sold', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Orders by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Order Type', fontsize=9)
ax4.set_xticklabels(ax4.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
